markitdown-cli.name: markitdown-cli
markitdown-cli.description: Convert documents to Markdown using Microsoft's MarkItDown library: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, YAML, EPUB, ZIP, Outlook .msg, Jupyter notebooks, images (with optional local OCR), and audio. Use when asked to convert, extract text from, or read a document/attachment/slidesheet/spreadsheet into Markdown or plain text for analysis, archiving, or LLM consumption.

video-miner.name: video-miner
video-miner.description: Extract, transcribe, and synthesize knowledge from video files or URLs into structured markdown notes using local speech-to-text (Nemotron ASR), smart visual frame sampling with deduplication, text gating (Imajev), and multi-column layout & code extraction (LightOnOCR-3-1B). Built on ICM (Interpretable Context Methodology) with staged folders and human review checkpoints.
